title: Lamb Tagine with Cozy Spices
description: A hearty, comforting lamb tagine with warm, aromatic spices. Serve with fluffy basmati rice and naan bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb pieces in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add cumin seeds; let sizzle for 1 minute.
Add onion, ginger, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, and salt; cook until onion is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add browned lamb back to pot and stir to coat with spice mixture.
Add water to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over basmati rice and with naan bread.
